name: Clovercrest Town
chat: The windmill grinds our flour. And sometimes our nerves.
Help yourself to an apple. Just one!
The hay bales are not for sitting. Fine, they are.
Our clinic is small but the nurse is very kind.
Don’t chase the chickens. They know where you live.
The sheep are called Wool, Wooler and Woolest.

props.say: Farmer: “Carrots! Fresher than any Billie’s smile.”
